segments.sourceText: Commander, we have reached Moonspire.
Kael, keep the oathstone close.
Serin, the Starward Order needs you.
We survived Starfall together.
By the stars, I will not run.

Kael, look at me.
The oathstone is safe.
Serin is waiting at Moonspire.
The Order will remember this night.

segments.sourceText: At dawn, Lady Serin returned to Moonspire.
Kael placed the oathstone on the table.
The Order had survived Starfall, but not without a cost.

segments.sourceText: "Commander, may I stay?" Kael asked.
Serin smiled. "By the stars, you already belong here."

Kael hurried after her, the oathstone cold in his hand.
